description: This PHP source file defines a class smpl_Quote_Sample that generates a PDF quote template for the SuiteCRM system, including methods for body content, header, and footer.

classes.name: smpl_Quote_Sample
classes.description: A class that provides methods to generate a quote PDF template, including body, header, and footer sections.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of document, which is 'AOS_Quotes'.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content for the quote PDF body, including company info, quote details, and product/service listings.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns an empty string as the header content.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content for the footer, including page number and date.
